network_status.network: Ingenio: 'Ponti a struttura mista: la complessa messa in sicurezza di uno dei ponti storici del Po'
network_status.summary_it: La fonte tecnica descrive l'instabilita della pila gia gestita con presidi urgenti dal novembre 2010 e il suo collasso nel marzo 2011, senza associare il cedimento a una piena specifica o pubblicare idrometria. Il dissesto fondazionale differito non viene ricondotto a un colmo arbitrario del Po.
network_status.summary_en: The technical source describes pier instability already managed with emergency works from November 2010 and its collapse in March 2011 without associating failure with a specific flood or publishing hydrometry. The delayed foundation failure is not assigned an arbitrary Po peak.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
